chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from some of his companions, from Milhan, from Abdullah ibn Sinan who said:

The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said: The worst of your women are the barren one who causes ruin, the impure/profane, the stubborn, the disobedient, the disgraceful among her people, the one who thinks highly of herself, the one who withholds from her husband, and the one who is loose with others.

key_terms.الذليلة: The disgraced, lowly, without honor among her people
key_terms.العاصية: The disobedient (to God and to husband)
key_terms.المعقرة: One who causes ruin/sterility; the barren one
key_terms.الهلوك: The one who craves (others); promiscuous outside marriage
key_terms.شرار: The worst, most evil (plural of شرير)

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about the worst qualities in a woman?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) describes eight blameworthy qualities that characterize the worst of women. This narration, transmitted through Abdullah ibn Sinan from the chain of al-Barqi, presents a moral catalogue of negative traits: barrenness paired with corruption, moral impurity, obstinacy, disobedience, social disgrace, arrogance, withholding from one's spouse, and unchastity outside marriage. The pairing of الْحَصَانُ (withholds from husband) with الْهَلُوكُ (craves others) is particularly notable, highlighting the contradiction between marital coldness and extramarital permissiveness as a grave moral failing.
